behavioral_intents: Detect credential theft via LSASS memory dumps using specialized dump utilities like procdump, rdrleakdiag, or direct tasklist/wmic enumeration combined with memory dump operations.

Detect execution of legitimate Windows system binaries from non-standard locations or with mismatched OriginalFileName metadata, a technique used to evade binary whitelisting and masquerade as system tools.
Detect credential dumping via diagnostic tools (LSASS memory extraction) and script-based remote code retrieval/dynamic code construction.
Detect execution of system binaries (cmd.exe, powershell.exe, etc.) from user-writable directories or non-standard locations, which indicates masquerading or evasion attempts.
